DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The audiometry confirms age-related hearing loss, but your history of sudden, position-dependent spinning is classic for BPPV. I need to perform a Dix-Hallpike maneuver to confirm the diagnosis before we can treat this.
